description: cinatra#2024 (S9 program acceptance) — design closeout row for criterion 1(e) only: 'mode: restricted actually restricts and lists denials'. This row adds the ONE dimension the pre-existing restricted-mode policy-evaluator suite did not yet cover: proving denials are LISTED (a denied tool is a reported catalog row, never a silent drop) against a CONCRETE, real S1 community-stack fixture write/destructive ability, not an abstract single denied ref. Scoped to this evidence item alone, not the full S9 closing report (a separate, later item). Follows the cinatra#2016 (S1) capture pattern (schemaVersion + provenance + verdicts[]) with the four-value verdict vocabulary (PASS | PENDING_GATE | FAIL | WAIVED/BLOCKED-UPSTREAM) this program adopted.

verdicts.item: restricted-mode-denial-listing (mode: restricted lists denials against a concrete ewpa/* write/destructive ability)

detail.runsIn: normal root Vitest suite (pnpm test:root) — no live stack
detail.whatThisRowAdds: the pre-existing restricted-mode truth-table tests in this same file already prove allow/deny/deny-precedence/absent-record/invalid-record in the abstract, against a single synthetic tool ref. This row proves the LISTING behavior criterion 1(e) actually names: evaluating a realistic mixed catalog (one allowed read plus two real S1 community-stack fixture mutation abilities) reports every row's status rather than silently omitting the denied ones, and specifically names the concrete denied tools rather than an abstract empty-catalog denial.

concreteFixtureAbilitiesUsed.source: the S1 community-stack fixture (cinatra#2016's own captured annotations, tests/e2e/wp-mcp-gateway/captures/annotations-c-gateway-triad.json) — real production ability names, not synthetic placeholders

detail.d3ChoiceApplied: per the design's D3 decision, this reuses the S1 community-stack fixture's real ewpa/* write/destructive abilities as the write/destructive fixture leg (option b — zero new PHP), rather than adding a synthetic write-annotated ability to scale-smoke-plugin. Reported here as its own distinct row, never merged into or implied by the scale-smoke-fixture's own evidence rows (cinatra#2255's governed-invoker-scale-verdicts.json) — this row is unrelated to and does not restate that fixture's evidence.
invariantsProven: a restricted-mode record with a narrow allow-list, evaluated against a 3-tool mixed catalog, reports a status for every row (nothing dropped — mirrors tools_list's own per-row policyStatus mapping, which never shortens the catalog)

the allowed read (ewpa/get-post) is listed 'allowed'; the real write ability (ewpa/update-post) and the real destructive ability (ewpa/create-code-snippet) are each listed 'denied' by name, not merged into one abstract denial

the same decision object that gates invocation (the invoker's step-2 policy floor throws tool_policy_denied on decision.status === 'denied') is asserted directly for the destructive ability — restricted mode blocks that ability's invocation path at the policy layer
deliberatelyNotDuplicated: absent-record default (restricted+empty) — already covered by this file's own 'absent record -> RESTRICTED+empty' test
deny-beats-allow precedence — already covered by this file's own 'deny beats allow' test
invalid-record fail-closed (unknown mode / malformed entry) — already covered by this file's own two 'invalid record' tests
server-qualified matching / stable-opaque serverId identity — already covered by this file's own 'server-qualified matching' describe block

the full end-to-end invoker-level block (throwing tool_policy_denied from a real invokeConnectorInstanceTool call, no wire call made) — already proven by src/lib/__tests__/connector-instance-invoker.test.ts's 'policy deny (restricted empty allow) -> tool_policy_denied' and its neighboring restricted-mode tests; not re-proven here, this row proves the packages/mcp-server policy-evaluator layer specifically, per the design's own 'where it runs' column
detail.postThetaReRunQueued: this row proves the mechanism against the tool names live TODAY (ewpa/* triad-server ability names, unaffected by the wordpress_post_get/update facade deletion the theta lane is soaking toward). Once theta lands and the final post-deletion tool-name census is available, this same suite should be re-run and re-cited against the final names as part of S9's later 'suites green: policy/census/classification, final form' row — that re-run is theta-gated and intentionally NOT claimed as done by this row.

localRun.environment: local (operator box) — pure unit-level policy-evaluator test, no live WordPress fixture required

provenance.hashingConvention: sha256OfFile from tests/e2e/wp-mcp-gateway/provenance.mjs (same algorithm the S1 capture set uses) — computed fresh in this repo tree, not copied from an unrelated capture
